## Added
- Spotify works like in the Msik bot: names, artists, covers and descriptions come from Spotify, the whole song plays through YouTube. No YouTube key needed any more, the server finds the right video itself (official uploads first, no covers, live or remix versions) and remembers it for all your devices
- Whole songs instead of 30 second previews for everything found in search
- Search in Everything, Spotify or YouTube Music, switchable above the results and in Settings. Spotify artists and albums open as their own pages with current pictures
- Right click menu in every app (long press on the phone) for songs, playlists, imported playlists, albums and artists. The "…" button opens the same menu
- Change the cover of a playlist: pick a picture, zoom and choose the part that should show
- Imported playlists stay pinned in the sidebar, with cover, next to your own playlists. Pin or unpin from the menu
- Pick which columns song lists show: cover, artist, album, source, length, year, genre, date added
- Accent colour "From cover" plus orange, pink, red and teal. All earlier colours stay
- Home suggests songs and artists based on what you listen to, also on Spotify and YouTube
- Desktop app: own dark title bar like Spotify with back, forward, home and search
- Phone: tap your picture for a panel with Settings at the bottom

## Fixed
- Imported Spotify playlists play instead of hanging at 0:00
- The visualizer moves with a beat for songs from YouTube and Spotify instead of standing still
- Choosing an accent colour works while a song plays
- Volume slider is white like on Spotify and shows its dot on hover
- Android: the page no longer runs under the status bar, the equalizer attaches reliably
- English is the default again; only a language you pick is kept
- Search field and filters on the phone have proper spacing
- Website: colours glide over when the next record starts instead of jumping early

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates, or install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
